about_short_description.short_description: The Arab World Massive Open Online Courses Platform (MOOC)

product.name: Rwaq Online Course Platform
product.description: An Arabic-language MOOC platform offering free and paid academic courses across various disciplines with interactive lectures, exercises, and assessments.

product.name: Academic Partnership Program
product.description: A service enabling academic institutions and organizations to create and manage their own courses on Rwaq with dedicated pages and full control over their educational content.

product.name: Instructor Program
product.description: A service for individual educators and professionals to deliver courses on Rwaq, providing tools to upload and manage educational content and interact with learners.

product.name: Custom E-Learning Initiatives for Organizations
product.description: A service for governmental and private entities to launch independent e-learning and training initiatives using Rwaq's technical and advisory support.
